thread:
maya: Heads-up — planning to upgrade hashicorp/aws provider from 4.60.0 -> 4.75.0 in the release window tonight 23:00 UTC. We'll also bump internal infra-modules v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0. This touches IAM role naming and TGW route attachments. DeployBot will run a preflight plan. Need ops + security signoff for IAM rename.

liam: :eyes: what's the rollback if role name changes break cross-account trust?

maya: rollback plan: revert module version + restore a prepared tfstate snapshot. We've also done a dry-run apply that only touches naming changes. Steps in the PR (https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/842) — includes state snapshot and restore playbook.

sophie: can we add lifecycle ignore_changes for policy attachments so we don't churn attachments during the rename?

maya: added suggestion in branch, snippet:
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "svc" {
  name = local.role_name
  lifecycle { ignore_changes = [ "assume_role_policy" ] }
}
```

deploy-bot: preflight plan finished — 4 resources to be changed, 2 replaces (aws_iam_role.svc, tgw_attachment). Plan output: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/842/checks/plan.

sam: staging canary targeted for 02:00 UTC. Ops-oncall ok to run with 15m observation window?

ops-oncall: ok for 02:00. set the canary SLOs: error rate > 2% OR attach latency > 10s => auto-rollback trigger. Will monitor logs and CloudWatch alerts.

deploy-bot: canary apply started (run id cb-1738000123). Streaming logs:
- applying module infra-aws v2.4.0
- creating aws_iam_role.svc...
- attaching tgw route 3/5...
canary metrics (T+6m): attach latency 8s, errors 0.6%

liam: looks good so far. watching. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary metrics (T+10m): attach latency spike to 12s, errors 2.3% -> rollback threshold breached. triggering rollback sequence.

maya: ack — aborting rollout. initiating rollback to infra-modules v2.3.1 and restoring tfstate snapshot snap-2026-03-21-0123. Notifying SRE and security.

deploy-bot: rollback started, restoring snapshot snap-2026-03-21-0123, running apply in restore mode. Logs:
- restored state for aws_iam_role.svc
- destroying created tgw_attachment.x (partial)
- apply complete, no outstanding replacements.

sophie: good call. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and update the release notes with the aborted rename and next steps. Also will add a module-level feature flag so renames are opt-in per-account.

maya: thanks everyone. reopening PR with migration plan and smaller opt-in rollout path. Will ping security for a final review before next canary.
